declarations.name: SpriteView
declarations.comment: The view to present your SKScene nodes in.

members.name: init
members.signature: nonisolated init(scene: SKScene, transition: SKTransition? = nil, isPaused: Bool = false, preferredFramesPerSecond: Int = 60)
members.comment:
Creates an instance with the given `scene`, `transition` and `isPaused` state.

- Parameters:
    - scene: SKScene to present
    - transition: the transition to use when presenting the scene.
    - isPaused: pauses the entire view if set to true
    - preferredFramesPerSecond: sets fps to define the desired rate for current SpriteView.
    Actual rate maybe limited by hardware or other software

members.name: init
members.comment:
Creates a new option set from the given raw value.

This initializer always succeeds, even if the value passed as `rawValue`
exceeds the static properties declared as part of the option set. This
example creates an instance of `ShippingOptions` with a raw value beyond
the highest element, with a bit mask that effectively contains all the
declared static members.

    let extraOptions = ShippingOptions(rawValue: 255)
    print(extraOptions.isStrictSuperset(of: .all))
    // Prints "true"

- Parameter rawValue: The raw value of the option set to create. Each bit
  of `rawValue` potentially represents an element of the option set,
  though raw values may include bits that are not defined as distinct
  values of the `OptionSet` type.

declarations.name: SpriteView.DebugOptions.ArrayLiteralElement
declarations.comment: The type of the elements of an array literal.

declarations.name: SpriteView.DebugOptions.Element
declarations.comment:
The element type of the option set.

To inherit all the default implementations from the `OptionSet` protocol,
the `Element` type must be `Self`, the default.

declarations.name: SpriteView.DebugOptions.RawValue
declarations.comment:
The raw type that can be used to represent all values of the conforming
type.

Every distinct value of the conforming type has a corresponding unique
value of the `RawValue` type, but there may be values of the `RawValue`
type that don't have a corresponding value of the conforming type.

declarations.name: SpriteView.Options
declarations.comment: Option set that's used to customize how nodes will be displayed in the view.

members.name: allowsTransparency
members.comment:
Toggles whether the view allows transparent rendering.

This allows content under the view to show through if a non-opaque backgroundColor is set on the scene. Defaults to false.

members.name: ignoresSiblingOrder
members.comment:
Ignores sibling and traversal order to sort the rendered contents of a scene into the most efficient batching possible.

This will require zPosition to be used in the scenes to properly guarantee elements are in front or behind each other.
This defaults to false, meaning that sibling order overrides efficiency heuristics in the rendering of the scenes in the view.
Setting this to true for a complex scene may substantially increase performance, but care must be taken as only zPosition
determines render order before the efficiency heuristics are used.

members.name: shouldCullNonVisibleNodes
members.comment: A Boolean value that indicates whether the view automatically culls non-visible nodes from the rendering tree.
